known.via: English Wikipedia "Côtes de Duras AOC" (redirects to "Côtes de Duras")

limits: For white wine, Colombard: at most 10%
For white wine, the minor grapes together: at most 25%
For rosé wine, the minor grapes together: at most 20%
rules.yield_base: 50 hl/ha for white, 55 for red and rosé

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A South West France appellation for red and white wine, in Lot-et-Garonne, just east of the Bordeaux border. Grapes allowed include Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Sauvignon, Sémillon and Muscadelle.
